<thought>To locate a template that can retrosynthetically generate a sulfonamide, I will search the template catalog using only the functional group formed ("sulfonamides") for the target molecule benzenesulfonamide. This avoids the invalid bond format requirement.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
